texts.en: The surface of [Planet.GetName] is scorching hot, and hostile to biological life. Images of clearly artificial ruins have therefore caught the attention of [GetScientistPlural]. An archaeological investigation could reveal who was here, and what happened to them.

sections.en: The surface of [Planet.GetName] is scorching hot, and hostile to biological life. Images of clearly artificial ruins have therefore caught the attention of [GetScientistPlural]. An archaeological investigation could reveal who was here, and what happened to them.

texts.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]遗迹初看似由石头构成，但挖掘和分析表明，许多建筑由石化的类木材有机物构成。现今行星上已无该材料来源。小型文物由粗制金属、玻璃及类似的石化有机物组成，[GetScientistPlural]还发现了已灭绝本土生物的化石。

该文明疑居于气候温和时期。他们是早已消失，还是目睹了巨变的尾声？
texts.en:
While the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName] first appeared to be built of stone, excavation and analysis suggests that many of the structures in this lost city are made of a petrified organic material comparable to wood. No source for such materials exists on the planet today. Smaller artifacts are built of crude metals, glass, and similar petrified organics, and [GetScientistPlural] have also found fossils of native creatures that no longer exist. 

It appears the civilization in question inhabited the planet at a time when its climate was much more temperate. Did they disappear long before the planet turned to its current state, or did they witness the violent transition in their final years?

texts.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]城市废墟中挖掘出若干具有文化价值的场所，墙面饰有复杂纹样，疑为某种文字。最激动人心的是，挖掘队发现一个密布书架的地下房间，摆满刻有繁复铭文的青铜薄板。青铜作为存储介质极为低效，但这里似乎是个公共文本档案库。

考古队正深入探索并开始破译文本。该文明的最终命运仍待揭晓。
texts.en:
Excavation of the ruined city on [From.Planet.GetName] has revealed places of cultural importance, decorated with intricate patterns that may be a written language. Most excitingly, the dig teams have found an underground chamber full of shelves, each containing thin sheets of bronze etched with densely-packed script. Despite the inefficiency of bronze as a storage medium, this appears to be a communal archive of texts. 

Translation attempts have begun as the archaeological teams continue to spread out through the city. The question of the final fate of these people remains open.

texts.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的团队发现了一处阴森的地下墓穴，由纵横交错的挖掘坑道构成，壁龛里叠放着三到四层木乃伊化的外星遗骸。陪葬品反映出该文明的科技面貌：有粗糙的火器、简易的玻璃望远镜，以及精细复杂的纺织刺绣。

墓穴的多个交叉口由本地已灭绝动物的雕像把守。这些生物有圆顶甲壳、四条矮腿和小而钝的脑袋；在保存良好的雕像中，它们蜷伏着以壳护身，抵御上方刻画的火焰。

这件艺术品的真实意涵或许已随时间消逝，但它很可能反映出社会对烈焰厄运即将来临的预感。若能深入发掘，或许能澄清该文明当年所经历之事。
texts.en:
The team on [From.Planet.GetName] has encountered a somber catacomb. It consists of a network of dugout trenches, with mummified alien remains resting in cavities in the walls, stacked three or four individuals high. Burial goods give us a glimpse of their technological development, such as primitive firearms, simple glass telescopes, and complex textile embroidery. 

Many junctions within the catacomb are guarded by statues of extinct local fauna. These creatures have a round, domed shell, four squat legs, and a small blunt head. In better-preserved specimens, they are depicted hunching down, using their shell to protect them from flame-like carvings in the material above them. 

The true meaning of this artwork may be lost to time, but it may depict this society's awareness of its impending, fiery doom. Further excavation of the ruins may clarify what they were experiencing.

texts.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]城市废墟的深入探索证明，该文明经历了生态系统的全面崩溃，并察觉到烈焰吞噬的末日逼近。最初他们以纸张记录历史，后因火山灰常年飘落，转而使用青铜板保存记录。艺术作品中频繁出现动物躲避火焰的场景，显然是在尝试理解并描绘自身的灭亡。

挖掘过程中还发现了一尊近乎完好的地下墓穴守卫雕像，其顶部雕刻的火焰散发出微弱的光芒，极具保护价值。

除此之外，我们还发现了他们试图阻止火山活动的证据，根据现存的道路与被毁的运输车可知，当地居民曾将碎石运往最近的火山口，企图封堵火山喷发，但终究未能改变灭亡的命运。如今，这颗行星早已不再存在任何多细胞生命。

此段历史警示我们，一旦遭遇超乎自身技术的难题，任何文明都岌岌可危。
texts.en:
Extensive exploration of the ruined city on [From.Planet.GetName] proves that this civilization lived through the collapse of its ecosystem, and knew its final, fiery days were approaching. Paper-based records existed before hot volcanic ashfall forced them to switch to bronze tablets, and artistic depictions of animals hiding from flame record their attempts to reckon with their own end. 

The excavation also uncovered a nearly perfect specimen of the catacomb guardian statues. The flames carved above it have an internal glow, making this a striking piece worthy of preservation. 

We also found evidence of attempts to stop the volcanism. Roadways and broken carts demonstrate that the inhabitants transported rubble to the nearest volcanic caldera and dumped it in to try to plug the volcano. Unfortunately, they were unable to stop their fate. The planet is devoid of multicellular life today. 

This history reminds us of the precarity of any civilization, should it encounter a problem more powerful than the tools it has at its disposal.

label.en: We should learn from their mistakes.
